blocks.text: Skills over MCP is now in public beta in Claude, so MCP servers can ship skills alongside their tools. We're also giving servers ways to handle longer, more interactive work with Claude: Tasks and Elicitation are now generally available, and File Uploads is rolling out soon.

inlines.text: Skills over MCP is now in public beta in Claude, so MCP servers can ship skills alongside their tools. We're also giving servers ways to handle longer, more interactive work with Claude: Tasks and Elicitation are now generally available, and File Uploads is rolling out soon.

blocks.text: Two years ago, Anthropic launched the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a new standard for connecting AI agents to the systems where data lives. The spec has kept evolving to meet the connectivity needs of agents in production, and is becoming foundational for agentic messaging and orchestration.

inlines.text: Two years ago, Anthropic
launched the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

as a new standard for connecting AI agents to the systems where data lives. The spec has kept evolving to meet the connectivity needs of agents in production, and is becoming foundational for agentic messaging and orchestration.

blocks.text: With today’s updates, Claude can work with a server more like it works with another agent: learning from it, delegating to it, and exchanging input and files along the way.

inlines.text: With today’s updates, Claude can work with a server more like it works with another agent: learning from it, delegating to it, and exchanging input and files along the way.

blocks.text: Ship expertise alongside tools with Skills over MCP

inlines.text: Ship expertise alongside tools with Skills over MCP

blocks.text: Tool names and descriptions tell Claude what a server can do, but don't cover how to handle specific use cases. With Skills over MCP, servers can publish skills alongside their tools to help Claude take on longer, multi-step work. Claude loads a skill only when it's needed, keeping context use low. Skills update with the server, so developers can ship tools and guidance together and users have nothing separate to install.

inlines.text: Tool names and descriptions tell Claude what a server can do, but don't cover how to handle specific use cases. With
Skills over MCP

, servers can publish skills alongside their tools to help Claude take on longer, multi-step work. Claude loads a skill only when it's needed, keeping context use low. Skills update with the server, so developers can ship tools and guidance together and users have nothing separate to install.

blocks.text: Skills can cover best practices, step-by-step workflows, or even playbooks tailored to a user's account or organization. Using Skills over MCP:

inlines.text: Skills can cover best practices, step-by-step workflows, or even playbooks tailored to a user's account or organization. Using Skills over MCP:
Shopify
helps Claude design and update a merchant's online store end to end.
HubSpot
onboards customers and gets them set up in Claude.
Atlassian
helps Claude draw on deep organizational context for insights and work analysis.
Carta
will help Claude draft and issue equity from an uploaded document (coming soon).

blocks.text: Skills over MCP is in public beta in Claude and Claude Code, on by default for Pro, Max, and Ultra plans and available to Team plans once an admin enables it. Coming soon to Enterprise.

inlines.text: Skills over MCP is in public beta in Claude and Claude Code, on by default for Pro, Max, and Ultra plans and available to Team plans once an admin enables it. Coming soon to Enterprise.

blocks.alt: Skills over MCP (beta): an MCP server ships three layers to Claude. Skills carry domain knowledge tailored to each user or org, tools are actions Claude can take, and resources are context Claude can pull in. Skills load only when needed and update with the server.

blocks.text: MCP servers can now take on long-running, interactive work with Claude

inlines.text: MCP servers can now take on long-running, interactive work with Claude

blocks.text: Agents in production are taking on longer, more consequential jobs. Servers can now support that work by running it in the background, checking in with users, and receiving files from Claude.

inlines.text: Agents in production are taking on longer, more consequential jobs. Servers can now support that work by running it in the background, checking in with users, and receiving files from Claude.

blocks.text: Hand off long-running work with Tasks. Tool calls used to have to finish before Claude could move on. With Tasks, servers can run operations that take time, or even full agent loops, while Claude keeps working and picks up the result when it's ready. Using Tasks, ZoomInfo runs deeper accounts and contact research that previously took several prompts.

inlines.text: Hand off long-running work with

blocks.text: Ask for input mid-call with Elicitation. Some actions need a user’s sign-off, like spending money or deleting data. With Elicitation, a server can pause to ask the user for input through a form or link, then continue where it left off. Using Elicitation:

inlines.text: Ask for input mid-call with
Elicitation

Some actions need a user’s sign-off, like spending money or deleting data. With Elicitation, a server can pause to ask the user for input through a form or link, then continue where it left off. Using Elicitation:
Supabase
confirms costs before creating a paid project and before running destructive SQL.
Railway
asks before making potentially destructive changes, like removing a service.
GitHub
has users enter a repository's name before an agent deletes it.

blocks.text: Tasks and Elicitation are now generally available in Claude and Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Ultra plans, and rolling out to Team and Enterprise organizations.

inlines.text: Tasks and Elicitation are now generally available in Claude and Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Ultra plans, and rolling out to Team and Enterprise organizations.

blocks.text: Send and receive files with File Uploads. Claude will be able to pass files to MCP servers, not just text. The File Uploads extension sends PDFs, spreadsheets, and images to a server without passing them through the context window.

inlines.text: Send and receive files with
File Uploads
Claude will be able to pass files to MCP servers, not just text. The File Uploads extension sends PDFs, spreadsheets, and images to a server without passing them through the context window.

blocks.text: File Uploads is rolling out soon in Claude and Claude Code to Pro, Max, Ultra, and eligible Team and Enterprise plans.

blocks.text: Built on stronger foundations for connecting agents in production

inlines.text: Built on stronger foundations for connecting agents in production

blocks.text: Thanks to contributions from across the AI ecosystem, MCP now sees over 700 million monthly SDK downloads, and there are over 10,000 MCP connectors for Claude. We've worked with the MCP community to improve how MCP works in Claude. Over the past year, it has become:

inlines.text: Thanks to contributions from across the AI ecosystem, MCP now sees over 700 million monthly SDK downloads, and there are over 10,000 MCP connectors for Claude. We've worked with the MCP community to improve how MCP works in Claude. Over the past year, it has become:
More token efficient:
Tool search
loads tool definitions only when needed, which can cut the context they use by over 85% in multi-server setups.
Easier to scale:
The
latest MCP spec
is stateless and supported across Claude products, making it easier to build servers and maintain their reliability as they grow.
Simpler to authorize:
The
Enterprise Managed Auth
extension lets admins authorize supported servers once, so users connect automatically.
More interactive:
The
MCP Apps
extension brings full interfaces into Claude, beside the conversation or full screen.

blocks.text: Together, these improvements make MCP easier to build on and adopt, and give the standard a strong base to continue evolving for the needs of agents in production.

blocks.text: Thank you to the MCP community

inlines.text: Thank you to the MCP community

blocks.text: MCP is an open standard, hosted by the Agentic AI Foundation and shaped by the people who build on it. Two years of progress came from the maintainers, contributors, and developers who wrote the spec, built the SDKs, shipped servers, and added client support. Thank you for making MCP what it is today.
